words.word: it shall be a place for the spreading
thou shalt be a place to spread
they shall be a place to spread forth

occurrences.text: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.
words: It shall be a place for the spreading

occurrences.text: And I will make thee like the top of a rock: thou shalt be a place to spread nets upon; thou shalt be built no more: for I the Lord have spoken it, saith the Lord God.
words: thou shalt be a place to spread

occurrences.text: And it shall come to pass, that the fishers shall stand upon it from En–gedi even unto En–eglaim; they shall be a place to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.
words: they shall be a place to spread forth
